title: Protein-Skimmer Underperformance Alert
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reeftank:param metric="skimmate_ml"
| stats avg(value) as avg_skimmate_ml latest(pump_watts) as pump_watts by skimmer
| where avg_skimmate_ml<50 AND pump_watts>0
description: Flags skimmers that are drawing power but producing unusually little skimmate.
value: A skimmer can look alive while underperforming badly, so output versus power is a useful operational cross-check.
implementation: Record skimmate collection and pump wattage from the skimmer controller or manual maintenance notes.
visualization: Alert table of skimmers with low output despite active pumps.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when a skimmer is still running but not pulling out much waste anymore.
